name: Winter’s Chill
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level cleric/oracle 4, druid 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target one creature

Duration 1 round/level

Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

The subject experiences severe chills, causing him to believe he is rapidly freezing to death. If there is a source of warmth such as a smoldering hearth, open flames, or even a creature with the fire subtype in the subject’s line of sight, the subject must move toward the heat source as quickly as possible by the most direct route. The subject moves through threatened areas without hesitation, though it does avoid obviously hazardous locations such as a chasm in its path. When the subject reaches the heat source, the subject takes no actions other than to shiver uncontrollably. If there are no heat sources within the subject’s line of sight, the subject takes no actions while shivering uncontrollably. Despite the subject’s obsession with staying warm, the subject is not helpless.

After the spell ends, the subject can act normally. On the creature’s next turn, it may attempt a new saving throw to end the effect. This is a full round action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity. If this save is successful, the effect ends. If not, the creature continues to seek the closest source of warmth or remains motionless while shivering uncontrollably.

Creatures immune to cold and those with resistance to cold are immune to the effects of this spell.
